## Problem

<!-- The problem in a sentence or two: what happens, what should happen, and how to reproduce it.
Link a related issue if there is one. -->

## Scope

<!-- Why this belongs in the integration and helps other installs too. See
CONTRIBUTING.md#belongs-in-the-integration. Name any related problem you left for a separate PR. -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes the problem. Mention changes to the services, the events or the event format

## Verification

<!-- The commands and manual checks you ran and what you saw, with the Home Assistant, AI Task

## Review

<!-- Who reviewed the full diff before you opened the PR: another person, or an AI agent with a
